bounded_host_request.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import os,sys
from tumblrkit.tumblr_read import adapter_from_env
owner=os.environ.get("TUMBLR_OWNER_BLOG","").strip()
reader=adapter_from_env()
if not owner or reader is None:
    print("TUMBLR_OAUTH_RUNTIME=NOT_CONFIGURED")
    sys.exit(61)
try:
    result=reader.perform("tumblr.list_posts",owner,{})
except Exception as error:
    print("TUMBLR_OAUTH_RUNTIME=CONNECTED_BUT_READ_FAILED")
    print("ERROR_TYPE="+type(error).__name__)
    sys.exit(62)
if result.get("verified") is not True or not isinstance(result.get("rows"),list):
    sys.exit(63)
print("TUMBLR_OAUTH_RUNTIME=VERIFIED_READ")
print("POST_COUNT="+str(len(result["rows"])))
PY
